Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.

elements.title: An African Song or Chant from Barbados (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that An African Song or Chant from Barbados (manuscript pictured) was nominated for inscription on UNESCO's Memory of the World International Register by someone who saw it in an online exhibition?

elements.title: Elisheva Biernoff (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Elisheva Biernoff paints recreations of found vintage snapshot photographs, some including details like lens flare and overexposure?

elements.title: an Ohio radio station (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that staffers of an Ohio radio station learned that it had been sold on the same day as its owner's death?

elements.title: A Narrative of the Travels and Adventures of Paul Aermont Among the Planets (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that A Narrative of the Travels and Adventures of Paul Aermont Among the Planets (1873), following the cancellation of a planned second edition, was not reprinted until 2018?

elements.title: Harold Harrington (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Harold Harrington did not seek out new species, but was the first to collect a plant that was later named after him?

elements.title: Mad about the Boy (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that fans of romcom heroine Bridget Jones were shocked at the death of a favourite character in the 2013 novel Mad about the Boy, and then again in a 2025 film?

elements.title: Eritha (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a Bronze Age priestess named Eritha was the focus of the first recorded legal dispute in Europe?

elements.title: Ard-al-Moharbeen necropolis (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Roman-era Ard-al-Moharbeen necropolis is the largest cemetery discovered in Gaza?

elements.contents: ... that the writer of "Crabs for Christmas" joked that it contributed to Baltimore's population decline?
